description:
Resolve free-form user text into the canonical brand / model identifiers
the other tools expect. Meant for phones named in free text: the other tools
match brands and models exactly, so a guessed spelling returns an empty
list.

Matching is substring-based and case-insensitive over brand, resolved model
name and raw Build.MODEL, ranked by exact match then popularity.

limit.description: Maximum brand hits and model hits to return (each list is capped separately).

query.description: Free text: a brand ('samsug'), a model name ('pixel 8'), a raw Build.MODEL code ('SM-S911B'), or both ('samsung galaxy s23').

name: search

brand.description: Canonical lowercase brand identifier to pass to the other tools.

url.description: Public BatterySnap page for the brand.

model.description: Canonical resolved model name (street name) to pass to the other tools.

url.description: Public BatterySnap page for the model; null when raw_model_code is null.

title: Search brands and models
